name: wpDataTables
couldBuild: Tables from CSV, Excel, Google Sheets or a SQL query, with sorting, filtering, pagination and a chart on top. Mostly a wrapper over well-known JS libraries.
stillMissing: Front-end editable tables writing back to a live database is the genuinely risky part — permissions, validation and concurrent edits. Everything else is scope: chart engines, formulas, conditional formatting and the import matrix.
requirements: Table sources: manual, CSV/Excel upload, Google Sheets and SQL query
Server-side processing so large tables stay responsive
Sorting, multi-column filtering and per-column search
Charts bound to a table's live data
